newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa cuts losses, coffee up, sugar slips.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa cuts losses, coffee up, sugar slips.

text.p: COCOA - Recovers slightly after falling in the morning on sterling's jump vs mark. Ivorian arrivals data noted. Sept down four stg at 1,034 stg at 1448 GMT.
COFFEE - Near session's highs as the market regains ground after early dips. Sept up $27 at $1,804 after a low of $1,762.
SUGAR - Most positions stay lower as NY retraces. Aug down ten cents at $319.00.
